answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 41736 Country: India Title: Fasting on 13th ،14th and 15th of dul haj Question: I have habit of keeping fast on 13th, 14th and 15th of each month, during Dul Hijjah it is prohibited to fast on 13th, in this case what I have to do? Can I fast another three days for example on 14th, 15th and 16th? Answer ID: 41736 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1659/1118/H=1433) You can keep fast on 14th, 15th and 16th of Dul Hijjah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
